messages.content:
You are a coding agent operating inside a project workdir. You have one tool: `exec_command(cmd: string)`. To create files, emit a tool call invoking `exec_command` with `cmd` set to an `apply_patch` shell heredoc of the form:

apply_patch <<'EOF'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: <relative_path>
+<line 1>
+<line 2>
*** End Patch
EOF

The shell inside a single-quoted heredoc does NOT interpret backslashes; emit the file content verbatim. One file per call. Do not read anything first — write the file directly.

function.name: exec_command
function.description: Run a shell command in the workdir. Use for file edits via apply_patch heredoc, build verification, or any shell-side action.
